measured_against: the live database, through store.effectivity.candidate_filter -- the same predicate the lexical and pgvector ranking statements interpolate

valid_time.claim: an as-of query returns the revision in force for the machine at that date

knowledge_time.claim: the same machine at the same as-of date returns what was believed then when a knowledge date is pinned, and what is believed now when it is not

on_the_day_the_correction_landed.note: the knowledge interval is half-open, so the correction applies from its own known_from

a_later_correction_does_not_rewrite_hist.claim: the correction is already stored, and the historical query still returns the belief it replaced -- which an UPDATE would have destroyed
